appearances.snippet: That's not true. Mikey (Mikey McCoy) was a mess. According to my sources, Mikey (Mikey McCoy) was a mess at the hospital.

verification.notes: The transcript explicitly attributes this subjective description of Michael McCoy’s hospital behavior to unnamed sources. Live searches found no identified eyewitness account or official record that could establish his emotional or operational condition. The anonymous private-source claim cannot be verified.
